claims.claim: On November 20, 2026, Anthropic’s shares fell during their second trading session while the Nasdaq erased its gains for the year; the broader AI-linked sell-off followed a record-setting IPO debut rather than being stopped by it.
claims.source_title: Nasdaq erases all 2026 gains as AI sell-off dampens Anthropic’s second day of trading

claims.claim: The central market concern is not that AI has stopped working, but that AI-company valuations may have risen faster than profits. Investors are questioning whether demand for processors, memory and data-center equipment can remain strong if AI businesses are less profitable than expected.
claims.source_title: A 10% drop for the stock market is unnerving, but it’s not that unusual

claims.claim: AI infrastructure requires unusually large upfront spending. The Federal Reserve reported that advanced-computing-related borrowing rose from less than 6% of investment-grade corporate debt issuance in 2023 to about 31% in 2026, increasing the financial system’s exposure to the buildout.

The scale of expected spending helps explain why investors are demanding evidence of returns: Morgan Stanley estimated that hyperscalers could spend about $3.8 trillion from 2026 through 2028, with credit markets likely financing more than half of it.
claims.source_title: How Credit Markets Are Financing AI Infrastructure

claims.claim: NVIDIA is especially exposed to changing expectations because its chips are central to the AI industry and its valuation depends heavily on continued infrastructure demand. AP reported that the sell-off reflects a need for earlier capital spending to translate into measurable earnings and returns.
claims.source_title: A 10% drop for the stock market is unnerving, but it’s not that unusual

claims.claim: For startups, a market reset can mean less generous valuations and more pressure to show revenue before raising money. A November 11 report said venture investors were already applying more conservative revenue multiples in AI funding discussions during the public-market sell-off.
claims.source_title: OpenAI, Anthropic valuations fuel VC fears of startup correction

claims.claim: Retirement savers may see account balances move with the sell-off if their 401(k) plans or funds hold technology-heavy stocks. SEC investor guidance says stock and stock-fund values can fall quickly and that diversification can reduce, but cannot eliminate, market losses.
claims.source_title: Beginners’ Guide to Asset Allocation, Diversification, and Rebalancing

claims.claim: The market decline does not determine the eventual price of AI services. Separate research on AI inference markets found substantial quality-adjusted price declines, suggesting that competition and efficiency can make AI cheaper even while the companies supplying it face pressure to justify their spending.
claims.source_title: The Price of Intelligence: A Quality-Adjusted Price Index for AI Services
